method: Parse overs as six-ball units: the digit after the point is a ball count from 0 to 5, not a decimal fraction of an over. For one pair of completed innings, scoring rate is runs scored times 6 divided by balls counted for, and conceding rate is runs conceded times 6 divided by balls counted against. Net run rate is scoring rate minus conceding rate. When the batting side is all out, count the full scheduled over quota instead of the actual overs faced; otherwise count actual overs. Actual overs may not exceed the quota. Competition-specific DLS, Super Over, abandoned-match and tie adjustments are outside the calculation.
